service.description: The leave policies of the employers an HR reader reads, by name or id (term, ignoring case), of an employer (organizationPartyId; ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope) and a leave type, those in effect on asOfDate (now when empty) unless includeEnded. Each with its employer, leave type, unit, terms, accrual (its steps in effect, in words), dates, state, how many employments it has now or to come, whether the caller may change it and its revision. Paged. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_HR_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).

service.description: One leave policy an HR reader of its employer reads: its row as find#Policies gives it, how many ledger entries were posted under it and whether the caller assigns it; its accrual steps (every dated step, those in effect first: months of service, amount a period, cap, carry-over limit, rounding, dates, state); the employments under it (now, to come, and ended; at most 500), each with the person, dates, opening balance, state and revision; and its blocked and mandatory days (kind, days, department, leave type, whether an approver may override, reason, state, revision). Refuses one outside the scope as missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new leave policy of an employer (organizationPartyId, an HR editor's) from fromDate (today when empty): its name, leave type (a current value of People's leave types), unit (LuDays, the default, or LuHours), whether it is paid (yes by default), whether a request needs an allocation (yes by default), its negative limit (zero by default), whether a request needs evidence, its accrual frequency (LafMonthly, LafQuarterly, LafYearly; none: allocations only) and description. Or a change of one at its revision (expectedRevision): its name, description and terms (audited, with changeReason), its unit while nothing was posted under it (UNIT_IN_USE), its frequency while no accrual was posted (FREQUENCY_IN_USE); and with end, its close from thruDate (today or later): no new assignment and no accrual from then, what was posted kept. Posted entries never change. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED). Refuses: ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED, NAME_REQUIRED, TYPE_INVALID, UNIT_INVALID, LIMIT_INVALID, FREQUENCY_INVALID, a policy outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), REVISION_CHANGED, another employer (OWNER_CHANGE), another leave type (TYPE_CHANGE), DATE_PAST.

An accrual step of a policy at its revision (expectedRevision): added from fromDate (today, or the policy's start when later, when empty), changed from fromDate (before the step's start in place; after it the step ends then and another starts, so the periods posted keep their entries) or, with end, ended from fromDate. serviceMonthsFrom is the months of service it applies from (0 by default; the step with the most months reached applies), amount what accrues each period of the policy's frequency, capAmount the balance an accrual does not pass, carryLimit the balance kept at a year's end (the rest expires; none keeps it all), roundingIncrement the step amounts round to (0.01 when none). Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the policy's employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope). Refuses: REVISION_CHANGED, FREQUENCY_REQUIRED (the policy accrues nothing), DATE_OUTSIDE (the policy is closed), DATE_PAST (a date before today once accruals were posted under the policy), SERVICE_INVALID, AMOUNT_INVALID, CAP_INVALID, CARRY_INVALID, ROUNDING_INVALID, OVERLAP (another step for the same months of service in effect then), RULE_ENDED.

Employments put under a leave policy from fromDate (today when empty) through thruDate (open when empty): those named (partyRelationshipIds, or one partyRelationshipId), else the current employees of the policy's employer, of departmentPartyId and the units under it when given (by the assignment in effect now); at most 500. Each in its own transaction under the employment's lock, a refusal named by its code and the rest going on: EMPLOYMENT_OUTSIDE (not of the policy's employer), DATE_OUTSIDE (not employed then), ASSIGNMENT_OVERLAP (under another policy of the leave type then), UNIT_MISMATCH (a balance of the type kept in another unit). openingAmount, when given, posts the opening balance once on the start. With operationKey, a retry answers the rows already assigned as repeated. With preview, the rows and their outcome, nothing written. Or with end, the assignment leavePolicyAssignmentId ended from thruDate (today when empty) at its revision (expectedRevision), with reason; posted accruals are not recalculated. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the policy's employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope). Refuses: DATES_INVALID, POLICY_NOT_IN_EFFECT, POLICY_CLOSED, AMOUNT_INVALID, DEPARTMENT_INVALID, REVISION_CHANGED, ASSIGNMENT_ENDED.

service.description: Days entered on a policy (leavePolicyId) on which leave is blocked or mandatory (blockKindEnumId LbkBlocked, the default, or LbkMandatory) for the policy's employer, narrowed to a department of it (departmentPartyId) and a leave type (leaveTypeEnumId; every type when empty), from fromDate through thruDate (whole days), with whether an approver may override a blocked day and why; or a change of them (leaveBlockedIntervalId) at their revision (expectedRevision), or with cancel their cancellation (kept). Approved leave is not cancelled: overlappingRequests lists the requests waiting or approved on the days (of the leave type and department, when named) for review: leaveRequestId, personName, fromDay, thruDay, statusEnumId; no reason. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope). Refuses: DATE_REQUIRED, DATES_INVALID, KIND_INVALID, DEPARTMENT_INVALID, TYPE_INVALID, REVISION_CHANGED, BLOCK_CANCELLED.
The in-parameters preview#Allocation and allocate#Leave share: the policy, who (named employments, else a department's or the employer's current employees), and the grant or adjustment.

The employments a grant of leave under a policy for an entitlement period (periodFromDate through periodThruDate, amount, expiryDate when what is left expires) or a reasoned adjustment (adjustment, a positive or negative amount) would reach: those named, else the current employees of the policy's employer, of departmentPartyId and the units under it when given; at most 500. Each with its person, balance now and outcome: ready, or refused by its code (EMPLOYMENT_OUTSIDE; NOT_ASSIGNED, not under the policy in the period; DUPLICATE_PERIOD, a grant of the policy for an overlapping period already; NEGATIVE_LIMIT, a deduction below the policy's limit). The count ready, the total and its unit, and the operation key the confirmation posts with. Nothing is written. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the policy's employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope). Refuses: AMOUNT_INVALID, REASON_REQUIRED (an adjustment), PERIOD_REQUIRED (a grant), DATES_INVALID, EXPIRY_INVALID, DEPARTMENT_INVALID.

service.description: A previewed grant or adjustment posted (operationKey, the preview's; OPERATION_REQUIRED without one): each employment in its own transaction under its lock, checked again as preview#Allocation checks it, an allocation (LeaveAllocation) and its ledger entry (a grant effective on the period's first day, an adjustment now or on its date) posted once per operation key and employment, so a retry answers the rows already posted as repeated; a refusal named by its code and the rest going on. A balance is never overwritten. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the policy's employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope); refuses as preview#Allocation does.

service.description: Leave balances as of asOfDate (now when empty; a date alone is its end): the caller's own (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE), their live reports' at the line's employers (PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW) and the employments of an HR reader's employers current then (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW); narrowed to an employment (partyRelationshipId; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope), a person, an employer (ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope), a department and the units under it (by the assignment in effect then) or a leave type. One row per employment and leave type with entries by then or a policy in effect then: the person, employer, leave type, unit, policy in effect, the movements by kind (opening, granted, accrued, consumed, expired, adjusted), the balance, pending (what the requests waiting for approval reserve), what is available (the balance less pending), the negative limit and whether the caller reads its movements (find#Ledger: the person and HR). Paged by employment. Refuses a caller with none of the three permissions (PERMISSION_DENIED).

service.description: The caller's own leave balances (get#Balances in self scope: no person, employment or organization parameter, so nothing widens it), as of asOfDate (now when empty), of a leave type when given: for each of their current employments and leave type, the policy, the movements by kind, the balance, pending reservations and what is available. The Assistant's tool for "how much leave do I have" (BOSS's AgentToolExposure, never MCP). Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

An employment's leave movements (the person's own, or an HR reader's of the employer; a manager reads balances alone, and anyone else is refused alike: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), of a leave type when given, effective from fromDate through asOfDate (now when empty), newest first: each with its date, kind, leave type, amount and unit, the balance after it, what it came from (an allocation and its reason, an accrual period and policy, an opening, an expiry and why) and when it was posted; the balances before fromDate; and the employment's legacy EmploymentLeave rows, labelled historical, read only and counted in no balance (dates, type, approved; never a reason). Paged; an export (pageNoLimit) takes up to 5,000 rows.

service.description: An HR editor's run of the leave accrual by asOfDate (now when empty, never later) for a policy of their employers (leavePolicyId; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope) or every policy of them: each assignment in its own transaction (accrue#Assignment), a failure logged by its employment and policy and the rest going on. What was posted is not posted again: a second run posts nothing. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED).

The run_LeaveAccrual job (daily): every policy assignment started by now and not ended more than a year ago (or those of partyRelationshipIds), each in its own transaction (accrue#Assignment), a failing one logged by its employment and policy and the rest going on; a rerun posts nothing again.

Internal to run#Accrual and run#AccrualJob, which check the caller: what one policy assignment has due by asOfDate (now, never later), under the employment's lock, in date order, each posted once by its source key: each ended accrual period of the policy's frequency (keyed by employment, policy and period; in arrears, the step in effect on the period's last day for the months of service then, in proportion to the days covered, rounded, not above the cap), at a year's end the balance above the carry-over limit expired (keyed by employment, leave type and year), and what is left of a grant after its expiry day (keyed by the allocation). Posts nothing that was posted.

What a leave request names, preview#Request and submit#Request alike: the employment (partyRelationshipId; the caller's own when they have one employment), the leave type, and its days: segments, a list of {fromDate, thruDate, dayPartEnumId}, or one given by fromDate, thruDate (the first when empty) and dayPartEnumId (LeaveDayPart: LdpFull, the default, LdpMorning or LdpAfternoon, a morning or an afternoon being of one day).

What a leave request would be, before it is made: the policy of its type the employment is under on its first day, each day with the hours its working schedule plans (a standard Monday-to-Friday week of 8 hours with none), its holiday (of the schedule's calendar or the employer) and what it charges in the policy's unit (a whole working day a day or its hours, a morning or an afternoon half of it, a day off or a holiday nothing), the total, the balance, what the other requests waiting reserve, what is available and what is left; the blocked and mandatory days on them, the approvers of its route; problems that block it (NO_POLICY, NOTHING_CHARGED, BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT when the policy needs an entitlement and the leave passes the negative limit, OVERLAP with another request of the day and part, BLOCKED_DAY, DATE_OUTSIDE the employment, NO_APPROVER: no one may decide a step) and warnings (BLOCKED_OVERRIDABLE, MANDATORY_DAYS, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED). The person (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE) for their own employment, or an HR editor of the employer (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT); another employment is refused as missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Refuses: EMPLOYMENT_REQUIRED, TYPE_REQUIRED, TYPE_INVALID, DATE_REQUIRED, DATES_INVALID, PART_INVALID, TOO_LONG, SEGMENTS_OVERLAP.

service.description: A leave request made: assessed again under the employment's lock as preview#Request does and refused with its first problem (the code, every message), then kept with its segments, what it charges (reserved while it waits) and the person's reason (ai-opt-out: read on the request alone), and sent for a People approval of kind PakLeave (the PeopleLeaveApproval topic to the first step's approvers; the person's manager unless a rule says otherwise). A retry with the same operationKey answers the first (repeated).

A leave request the caller reads (the person, who asked for it, HR of the employer, the person's manager there, an approver of it; another is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): the request (person, employer, leave type, policy, days, what it charges, state, dates, the reason only to the person, who asked, the approvers and HR, and its revision), its segments, each day with what it charges, the balance statement (the balance, what the other requests reserve, this request, whether it is reserved or taken, what is left), blocked days on it, the approval (steps, decisions, who decides now, canDecide), the decision notice (the outcome, who decided, when, a refusal's reason) and what the caller may do: canDecide (an approver of the step waiting), canWithdraw (the person or who asked, while it waits), canAskCancel (the person, of approved leave), canCancel (an HR editor of the employer, at once).

A leave request decided, under its employment's lock. approve or refuse: the step waiting, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision at the request's revision (sourceRevision from a notice); the last approval of a request recounts its days, checks the other requests of its days and the balance with the other reservations (refused with the problem, nothing recorded: BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT, OVERLAP, BLOCKED_DAY, NOTHING_CHARGED) and posts the leave taken once (when the policy keeps a balance), approves it and projects it (WetTimeOff "Out of office" work efforts the capacity and calendars read, a leave-start reminder for the person); the last approval of a cancellation posts the reversal once and cancels the projection; a refusal needs a reason (refused leave, or the cancellation refused: approved again). withdraw: the person or who asked, while it waits (its approval superseded). cancel: approved leave; the person asks it (cancellation asked, sent for approval as a request is), an HR editor of the employer cancels it at once with a reason. The person (and who asked) is told the outcome (PeopleLeaveDecision: the days and the outcome only). A decision retried answers the first (repeated). Refuses: DECISION_INVALID, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, REVISION_CHANGED (expectedRevision for withdraw and cancel), NOT_YOURS, NOT_PENDING, NOT_APPROVED, CANCEL_PENDING, REASON_REQUIRED and record#Decision's refusals (NOT_APPROVER, SELF_APPROVAL, ALREADY_DECIDED, SOURCE_CHANGED).

service.description: The PeopleLeaveApproval topic's refuse service, with the reason (the topic requires one): as approve#Request, the request refused (or a cancellation refused: the leave stays approved).

The leave requests the caller reads: their own (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; mine for those alone), their live reports' at the line's employers (PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW), those whose step waiting they decide (PEOPLE_REQUEST_APPROVE) and an HR reader's employers' (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW); narrowed to a person, an employer, states (statusEnumId, a comma list), a leave type, days from fromDate through thruDate, and toDecide (those the caller decides now). Newest first, paged; each with the person, employer, leave type, days, part, what it charges, state, whether the caller decides it and whether it is their own; never the reason. Refuses a caller with none of the four permissions (PERMISSION_DENIED).

service.description: The team calendar's items from start through end (yyyy-MM-dd; a month from today when empty), as Commons' Calendar.qvue takes them: the approved leave (and leave whose cancellation waits) of the people the caller sees, their own (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE), their live reports' at the line's employers (PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW) and an HR reader's employers' (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW), each segment as "{person} · Out" (a morning or an afternoon said so), kind absence, read only, with its leaveRequestId and whether the caller opens the request (openable); never the leave type, the reason or a refused request. Refuses a caller with none of the three permissions (PERMISSION_DENIED).

The Team absence projected CalDAV collection's owner service (mantle.work.CalendarDavServices, the CalendarProjection PeopleTeamAbsence): admitted is whether the caller sees absences (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE, PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW or PEOPLE_HR_VIEW); without checkOnly, the absences get#TeamAbsences shows them from start through end (epoch millis; 90 days back to a year ahead when none) as the ICalendar tool's event maps: "{person} · Out", never the leave type or the reason.
